general.defaultFileOpenTargetDesc: Choose the app used by the project header’s Open Location button. Leave it automatic to keep the existing selection rules.
general.showMenuBarIconDesc: Keep an OpenCodex icon in the system menu bar or tray so the app can be reopened after its main window closes.
general.hideDockOnCloseDesc: Hide the macOS Dock icon after the main window closes and restore it when the window reopens.
general.quotaDisplayDesc: Choose providers to show in the bottom-left menu and drag to customize their display order. All providers are off by default.
general.quotaEmpty: No provider API keys or OAuth accounts are configured yet.
general.quotaUnsupported: Quota display is not supported for this provider
general.openCodeGoSetupDesc: Paste your OpenCode Go API Key from the opencode.ai console (https://opencode.ai/auth). The quota is fetched from the official usage endpoint and stored encrypted.
general.openCodeGoApiKeySaved: Securely saved; leave blank to keep it
general.openCodeGoSaveFailed: Failed to save OpenCode Go API Key
general.openCodeGoRemoteUnsupported: OpenCode Go quota queries currently support only the local Runner.
general.openCodeGoManagedByEnvironment: API Key is provided by the OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY environment variable. Change it in the app launch environment.

speechModel.title: Voice Model
speechModel.description: After you stop voice input, the recording is sent to the configured transcription service. The result is inserted into the composer and is never sent automatically.
speechModel.desktopOnly: Voice model configuration is only available in the desktop app.
speechModel.serviceDesc: Choose the audio protocol used by the service. Any provider works when its API matches the selected protocol.

providerDesc.openai-transcription: Calls POST /audio/transcriptions and uploads the recording as multipart/form-data.
providerDesc.openai-chat-audio: Calls POST /chat/completions with raw Base64 input_audio and a transcription prompt for the standard audio-message protocol.
providerDesc.dashscope-chat-audio: Calls POST /chat/completions with Data URL input_audio and asr_options for Alibaba Qwen-ASR.
providerDesc.openrouter-transcription: Calls POST /audio/transcriptions with a JSON input_audio containing Base64 audio.

speechModel.baseUrlHint: Enter the API root, such as https://api.openai.com/v1. The app appends the request path for the selected protocol.
speechModel.modelOptionsAvailable: Found {{count}} likely speech models. You can still type a different model name.
speechModel.modelManualHint: Select Load models to query the service's GET /models endpoint, or enter a model name manually.
speechModel.languageHint: Leave blank for automatic detection, or enter an ISO-639-1 code such as zh or en.
speechModel.apiKeyPlaceholder: Enter the speech service API key
speechModel.apiKeyPreserved: Configured; leave blank to keep it
speechModel.apiKeyHint: The key is stored in encrypted system credential storage, not in the regular settings file.

archived.title: Archived Chats
archived.description: Archived chats are grouped by workspace. Restoring returns them to the sidebar; permanent deletion physically removes the session and its messages.
archived.deleteWarning: You are about to permanently delete “{{title}}”. Its session, messages, and parts will be physically removed and cannot be recovered.

imBot.title: IM Bots
imBot.desktopOnly: The IM bridge is only available in the OpenCodex desktop app.
imBot.serviceDescription: Run the IM message bridge in an isolated process connected to the selected OpenCode Server.
imBot.connectionDescription: Messages received by bots create or continue tasks on this server and working directory.
imBot.channelsDescription: Enable one or more platforms and enter credentials created in their bot consoles.
imBot.modelsLoadFailed: Failed to load models. Check the selected server connection.
imBot.allowedChatIds: Allowed Chat IDs (comma-separated; empty allows all)
imBot.allowedChannelIds: Allowed Channel IDs (comma-separated; empty allows all)
imBot.securityWarning: IM messages can instruct the agent to work in the selected directory. Restrict bot visibility and preferably set Telegram Chat ID or Discord Channel ID allowlists. Configuration is stored at ~/.opencodex/im-bridge with user-only permissions.
imBot.logsDescription: Shows the latest 300 bridge log lines for connection status, WeChat login prompts, and platform errors.
imBot.savedAndRestarted: Configuration saved; the bridge is restarting

servers.runnerDashboardDesc: Monitor local and self-hosted persistent Runners, capabilities, and project catalogs. New tasks and remote control use the selected Runner.
servers.handoffHint: Use Handoff from conversation search to transfer recent context and model selection to another online Runner.
servers.connectionsDesc: Manage backend endpoints and choose the default server for new tasks
servers.switchUnavailable: The server is unavailable. The default server was not changed.
servers.insecureHttpRequired: Remote HTTP is unencrypted. Confirm the risk below or use HTTPS.
servers.allowInsecureHttp: Allow unencrypted HTTP for this server. Credentials and task content may be visible on the network.
servers.name: Name
servers.localUrlLocked: Local server address is managed by the app and cannot be modified
servers.crossOriginWarning: Web/PWA cross-origin + password can be blocked by CORS preflight. The server must allow OPTIONS and the Authorization header.
servers.httpsIpWarning: HTTPS direct IP connections require a certificate that includes that IP. Private or self-signed CAs may not be trusted by desktop/mobile clients.
servers.credentialsStorage: Desktop credentials are encrypted with the system credential store. Web/PWA keeps them only in the current browser profile. Authentication uses HTTP Basic Auth.

hosting.title: Code hosting
hosting.description: Configure a token to create GitHub PRs, GitLab MRs, or Bitbucket pull requests directly
hosting.replaceToken: Enter a new token to replace it
hosting.secureStorage: Tokens stay in the desktop system's secure storage and are never written to project config or sent to the OpenCode Server.

servers.deleteServerConfirm: Remove "{{name}}" from the server list? This cannot be undone.

memory.proposalsDesc: Detect explicit preferences, conventions, and constraints in the current conversation. Nothing is persisted until you approve it.
memory.proposalApproved: The proposal was reviewed and saved to workspace Memory
memory.noProposal: No explicit durable preference or convention was detected in the current conversation
memory.unsupported: The current server does not support Memory management. Upgrade it or switch servers.
memory.globalDescription: Applies to every project and conversation and is added to the model context for each message. Manage project instructions and workspace memory from the right panel.
memory.captureDesc: Summarize conclusions worth retaining from the current chat and append them to workspace Memory.
memory.capturePlaceholder: For example: this project uses Bun; run bun typecheck before committing…

hooks.unsupported: The current server does not support Hooks management. Upgrade it or switch servers.
hooks.title: Hooks
hooks.description: Commands run in the current workspace, inherit only PATH and HOME, and have a 1–120 second timeout.
hooks.approvalWarning: The hook remains blocked until its exact command is explicitly approved.
hooks.unsandboxedWarning: This command may run with your full user permissions.
hooks.logsDesc: Keeps the latest 200 hook results with truncated output.

extensions.permissionsValue: Inherits the active Agent security policy
extensions.diagnosticHint: Connection state, install conflicts, version updates, and authentication errors appear within each category. The center restarts and refreshes the service when an install or removal requires it.

providers.title: Provider Connections
providers.desc: Reads the providers supported by the current opencode backend in real time. After saving an API key, open Models to see that provider's available models.
providers.configuredOnlyDesc: Show providers with a saved API key.
providers.empty: The current server did not return any providers
providers.noResults: No providers match the current search
providers.apiKeyConnectedPlaceholder: Saved. Enter a new key to replace it
providers.saveHint: Credentials are saved in local opencode auth storage and are not shown here again.
providers.copyKeyUnavailable: Could not read the saved key: local auth storage has no plaintext API key for this provider (OAuth logins do not expose one).
providers.copyKeyRemoteUnsupported: Remote runner credentials are not on this machine; only the local runner can copy a saved key.
providers.apiUnsupported: This provider currently exposes OAuth or another auth method; API key connection is not supported in this UI yet.

chat.pathsFormattingDesc: How file paths are displayed in messages and tools
chat.approvePendingOnFullAutoDesc: When enabled, switching the footer auto-approve control to this session or all sessions also approves already waiting permissions with once
chat.queueFollowupMessagesDesc: While a run is active, queue new messages for the next run by default; press Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Enter to steer the current run instead
chat.sidebarRecentsDesc: Optional folder view for recent chats
chat.conversationExperienceDesc: Message density, reasoning style, and step summary fields
chat.fileChangeIndicatorScopeDesc: Choose whether the top file change indicator counts only the latest turn or accumulates across the current session
chat.enterKeyBehaviorDesc: Choose what happens when you press Enter in the message composer
chat.browserOpenModeDesc: Choose whether login authorization, MCP auth, and terminal links open inside the app or in the system default browser

agent.behaviorDesc: Permission approval and queued message behavior
agent.backgroundSubagentsDesc: Allow agents to launch asynchronous background subagents. Changing this restarts the built-in local service; remote servers require their own environment setting.
agent.questionAutoContinueDesc: When enabled, if a question from the assistant is left unanswered for 5 minutes, it is automatically skipped so the assistant can continue.

models.visibilityDesc: Disable models you do not want to appear in the selector. Disabled models stay hidden across sessions on this server.
models.enabledOnlyDesc: Only show models that appear in the chat model selector.
models.keepOneEnabled: At least one model stays enabled so the chat can still send messages.
models.empty: No models available on the current server
models.noResults: No models match the current search

appearance.accessibilityDesc: Override system defaults for motion, contrast, target size, and keyboard focus.
appearance.reducedMotionDesc: Disable nonessential animation and smooth scrolling
appearance.highContrastDesc: Increase the visibility of borders and interactive controls
appearance.largeTargetsDesc: Increase minimum button and form-control height
appearance.visibleFocusDesc: Show a clear focus ring while navigating with Tab
appearance.themePresetsDesc: Choose a base visual style for the app
appearance.customCssDesc: Override fonts, colors, and any CSS variables. Works with all themes.
appearance.customCssHelp: Override fonts, colors, and styles with custom CSS.
appearance.customCssSpecificityHelp: Override fonts, colors, and styles. Use <1>:root:root</1> for higher specificity.
appearance.savedOverridesDesc: Name and switch between reusable CSS override snippets without changing the selected theme
appearance.glassEffectDesc: Apply backdrop blur to floating panels like input box, menus, and dialogs
appearance.fontScaleDesc: Adjust the overall interface font density
appearance.uiFontScaleDesc: Adjust the font size for menus, labels, and other UI elements
appearance.codeFontScaleDesc: Adjust the font size for code blocks, diffs, and terminal
appearance.codeBlockThemesDesc: Choose separate Shiki syntax themes for light and dark appearance
appearance.codeWordWrapDesc: Wrap code blocks and diffs to the available width to reduce horizontal scrolling
appearance.wakeLockDesc: Prevent the screen from dimming or locking while the app is in the foreground
appearance.languageDesc: Choose the display language for the interface
appearance.showChildSessionsDesc: Always list child sessions under their parent. When off, only active or selected children are shown.

workspace.layoutDesc: Workspace layout, reading comfort, and code viewing preferences
workspace.manualTerminalTitlesDesc: When enabled, terminal tabs stop following shell title changes and can be renamed manually. When disabled, terminal tabs continue to follow shell or process titles automatically.
workspace.terminalDesc: Terminal copy, paste, and mouse behavior. Basic paste and Ctrl/Cmd+C copy with a selection are always available.
workspace.terminalCopyOnSelectDesc: Automatically copy the terminal selection when the mouse is released. When off, selections are copied only with Ctrl/Cmd+C.
workspace.terminalRightClickPasteDesc: Right click copies the terminal selection when one exists, otherwise it reads clipboard text and pastes it. When enabled, this replaces the browser context menu.
workspace.sidebarDesc: Sidebar layout and recent chat organization

notifications.deliveryPolicyDesc: Control quiet hours, grouping, rate limits, and delivery channels. Permissions and questions remain in in-app history.
notifications.quietHoursDesc: Pause banners, sound, and system notifications during the selected period
notifications.groupBySessionDesc: Merge matching events from one conversation within two minutes
notifications.notifyWhenComplete: Notify when AI completes a response
notifications.onlyWhenUnfocusedDesc: Do not send system notifications while the app is visible and focused
notifications.testFailedDesc: macOS requires notifications to come from a signed app. Run the packaged OpenCodex.app and allow notifications in System Settings.
notifications.notAvailable: System notifications are not available in this environment
notifications.notificationTypesDesc: Choose which notification types are enabled
notifications.inAppAlertsDesc: Toast notifications for background session events
notifications.soundEnabledDesc: Play notification sounds for session events
notifications.currentSessionSoundDesc: Also play sounds for events in the active session
notifications.eventSoundsDesc: Configure notification sounds for each event type
notifications.eventPermissionDesc: When a session needs your approval
notifications.eventQuestionDesc: When AI is waiting for your input
notifications.eventErrorDesc: When a session encounters an error
notifications.supportedFormats: MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, AAC, WebM
notifications.soundNotSupported: Sound playback is not supported in this environment

config.title: Config
config.sourceDesc: Loads your global config and the effective config from the active server, then separates configured, inherited, and unconfigured fields.
config.sdkOnlyWarning: This editor uses the official OpenCode SDK only. It can add and modify config values, but the current official API does not support deleting arbitrary config fields.
config.noDeleteHint: Official SDK: add/modify only, delete is not supported.
config.noResults: No config fields match the current filters
config.configuredDesc: Fields already present in the user's global opencode config. Changes stay local until you click Save all.
config.unconfiguredDesc: Fields available in the official schema but not yet present in the user's global config. Add one to start configuring it visually.
config.noConfigured: No configured fields match the current search.
config.noUnconfigured: No unconfigured fields match the current search.
config.selectHint: Select a configured field to view and edit it, or choose an unconfigured field to add it.

logs.title: Logs
logs.debugLogsCardDesc: Export app and bundled server diagnostics for troubleshooting.
logs.debugLogsWarning: Debug logs can contain file paths, prompts, tool output, and other sensitive data. Review the file before sharing it.
logs.diagnosticsCardDesc: Collect versions, Runner and server health, security posture, and recent redacted logs.
logs.diagnosticsSafe: The report excludes passwords, API keys, tokens, server addresses, and user directories, so it is safe to attach to a bug report.
logs.diagnosticsCopied: Diagnostics copied. Credentials are excluded from the report.

backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.cardDesc: Export your local settings to a JSON backup, or restore them later on another device.
backup.warning: Backups contain every setting and configuration that can be migrated safely. Passwords, tokens, API keys, environment variables, webhook secrets, and runtime data are not exported. Automation prompts, directories, and server addresses are included, so do not share a backup publicly.
backup.includedPreferences: All UI, desktop, speech, and security preferences
backup.includedServerPreferences: OpenCode config, IM structure, automation definitions
backup.excludedCredentials: Passwords, API keys, tokens, IM secrets
backup.excludedRuntime: Session, notification, automation run, and diagnostic history
backup.excludedConfiguration: Service environment variables, memory contents, and caches
backup.importConfirm: Importing restores the settings and configuration in this backup, preserves local sensitive credentials, and reloads the app. Continue?
backup.importConfirmWithDate: Import the backup created at {{date}}? This restores its settings and configuration, preserves local sensitive credentials, and reloads the app.

about.title: About
about.versionCardDesc: View the current app version and bundled kernel version.
about.updateCardDesc: Check GitHub for the latest version. Updates must be downloaded and installed manually.
about.statusIdle: Check for updates to see whether a newer version is available.
about.statusUpToDate: You are already on the latest version.
about.statusDownloaded: Update downloaded, click to restart and install
about.toastBody: Click to open About and view the release page.

security.policyTesterDescription: Test whether a domain, IPv4, IPv6, or CIDR target is allowed before saving. Deny rules always take precedence.
security.enableSandboxDescription: Restrict file paths available to Agent tools and shell commands, and restrict command network access. Enabled by default.
security.enabledDescription: Enabled: Agent file tools and commands share path boundaries; commands also use the operating-system sandbox for filesystem and network restrictions.
security.disabledDescription: Disabled: Agent tools and commands no longer use these additional filesystem and network boundaries.
security.permissionDescription: Blocked file access requests permission in the task. Network access follows the allowlists strictly and cannot be bypassed temporarily.
security.windowsRuntimeReady: The sandbox user and credentials are installed and restricted commands are ready to run.
security.windowsRuntimeNeedsInstall: First-time setup creates a dedicated sandbox user and installs WFP network rules. One UAC prompt will appear.
security.windowsRuntimeMissing: srt-win.exe is missing from the application package, so the Windows sandbox cannot be enabled.
security.windowsRuntimeCancelled: The Windows UAC prompt was cancelled and no changes were made.
security.denyReadDescription: One absolute or ~ path per line. Allow-read rules take precedence.
security.allowReadDescription: Only add paths that the Agent genuinely needs.
security.allowWriteDescription: When empty, the project, Worktree, and temporary directories are allowed automatically. Dangerous system roots remain denied.
security.denyWriteDescription: Takes precedence over allowed writes and can protect files such as .env or release configuration.
security.allowedDomainsDescription: One domain per line. Supports *.example.com (excluding the apex domain). Unlisted domains are blocked.
security.deniedDomainsDescription: Explicitly blocks domains even when they match the allowlist.
security.allowedIPsDescription: One IPv4, IPv6, or CIDR range per line, such as 192.168.1.10, 10.0.0.0/8, or 2001:db8::/32.
security.deniedIPsDescription: Takes precedence over the IP allowlist. Supports exact addresses, CIDR ranges, and * to deny every direct IP connection.
security.blockPrivateNetworksDescription: Validate DNS results for allowlisted domains and reject loopback, private, link-local, reserved, and multicast addresses to prevent DNS rebinding into local services.
security.strictNetworkDescription: When the sandbox is enabled, commands can only reach allowlisted domains or IPs. File-access approval does not disable network isolation, and blocked commands are never retried outside the sandbox. Leave both allowlists empty for fully offline mode.
security.unixSocketsDescription: One socket path per line; usually left empty.
security.allUnixSocketsDescription: May expose host services such as Docker to the Agent. Keep disabled unless required.
security.localBindingDescription: Allow commands to start local development servers.
security.auditActivityDescription: Create a session log as soon as a message is sent and record assistant completion, command parameters, tool results, and code changes. Disabled by default.
security.storageFormatDescription: The built-in OpenCodex auditor writes structured per-session JSONL without loading external plugins.
security.status_idle: Save changes to restart the local service

keybindings.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
keybindings.clickToRebind: Click a shortcut to rebind. Enter confirm, Esc cancel.
